# dsh-side-chat-slash
A **side chat** for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI, built on `@flyer103/dsh-side-chat` 0.7.0.
> **This is a fork, not an original work.** The bulk of the code comes from flyer103's `dsh-side-cha
t` (MIT licensed). This repository adds only the changes listed below and keeps the original LICENSE
` (MIT licensed). This repository adds only the changes listed below and keeps the original LICENSE.
English | 中文
## What it does
Opens a **side conversation** next to the main session: it forks the current session into a child co
nversation that runs the **same agent, same tools and same workspace**, and can really edit files. C
lose it when done — the main transcript is never touched.
## Differences from upstream
| # | Change | Why |
| 1 | **New `/side` slash command** | Upstream only offers the right-sidebar guide card. `/side` + E
nter now opens a side-chat tab from the composer. Registered as a **host** command (`ctx.commands.re
gister`) rather than a client `commandUi` contribution, which depends on the session summary and a c

lient locale service and can silently disappear |
| 2 | **Open-request bridge** | `/side` does not c
reate a side session itself; it raises a "please open a tab" flag that the client polls (`/side-chat
/api/pending`, every 2s) and then calls `sidebarRight.openTab('side-chat')`. The tab still owns the

session, so upstream's one-tab-one-session (and close-disposes) lifecycle is preserved |
| 3 | **App
roval pinned to `never`** | Upstream inherits the parent's approval policy, but the side-chat tab re
nders no approval prompt — a parent on `ask` would leave the side agent waiting forever. A parent `a
sk` is now downgraded to `never` for the side chat |
## Install

`--profile` must name the profile you actually run: `desktop` for the Desktop app, `web` for a `dsh
ust name the profile you actually run: `desktop` for the Desktop app, `web` for a `dsh web` process.
Restart DSH afterwards (quit the Desktop app with ⌘Q and reopen it; restart a `dsh web` process).
## Usage

1. Open any session that has at least one message
2. Type **`/side`** in the composer and press Ente

r — a side-chat tab appears in the right sidebar
3. Send the first message in that tab; the fork hap

pens then, so an empty tab costs nothing
4. Close the tab to destroy that side chat; run `/side` aga

empty tab costs nothing
4. Close the tab to destroy that side chat; run `/side` again for a new one
The upstream entry point (the "Side chat" card on the right sidebar's guide page) still works.
## Relationship to the main session
- **Inherits** the full history at fork time, the same preset, cwd, provider/model and sandbox mode
- **Isolated**: side-chat turns never enter the main transcript, the session list or the subagent ca

talog
- **Independent**: main-session messages after the fork do not flow into it; each side chat ha

s its own context
- **Really edits files**: `write` / `edit` / `bash` act on the same workspace, so

the main session sees the change on its next read
- **Destroyed on close**: the side session's persi
sted log is removed (best effort)
## Known limitations (inherited)

- The side-chat tab does not render approval prompts (mitigated by pinning `never`)
- A closed tab c

annot be restored
- Each side chat's first request is roughly the size of the parent's next request;

N concurrent side chats multiply that
- GUI restarts lose every side session
- Web platform only (i
ncluding the Desktop window); no CLI/TUI surface
## Compatibility
| Item | Status |
| DSH version | Verified on `0.2.2-rc.1`; `package.json` declares `engines.dsh: >=0.2.2-rc.1 <0.3.0-
0`, so an incompatible host fails at install time instead of at runtime; DSH rejects an incompatible

host at install time |
| Platform | Tested on macOS; Windows/Linux untested (no platform-specific c

ode, expected to work) |
| UI | Web GUI only (Desktop window or `dsh web`); no CLI/TUI surface |
| N

ode | `>= 22` (satisfied by DSH's bundled runtime) |
| npm dependencies | **None**: imports no `@dee

pseek-ai/*` package |
| Browser module dependencies | **None**: requires only `react` (shell-provide

d) and `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-primitives` (platform seed table, with a built-in fallback) |
| H
ost services | Requires `agents`/`webServer`/`timer`/`commands`; degrades gracefully when `agentPres

ets`/`sandboxPolicy`/`approval`/`fileReferences`/`sessionPersistence` are absent |
| Coexistence | *
*Cannot** be installed alongside upstream `@flyer103/dsh-side-chat` (duplicate routes and tab type)
Cannot** be installed alongside upstream `@flyer103/dsh-side-chat` (duplicate routes and tab type) |

rejects an out-of-window host and explains that running it may crash or corrupt data. To try an unve

rified host anyway, use DSH's exact-version exemption:
